thread:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT [P1] — Spike of Stripe webhook failures and billing enforcement seen across prod.  ~50% webhook deliveries returning error codes related to account/quota; customers experiencing access errors for billing-protected routes. Investigating.

maria: I'm oncall. Looking at the dashboard — webhook consumer retries spiking, lots of 4xx from Stripe. Can people check payments logs + keys?

devin: seeing a flood of these in webhook-processor: `HTTP 429` and a JSON body: ```{\n  \"error\":{\"type\":\"invalid_request_error\",\"message\":\"account_quota_exceeded: webhook delivery disabled for account\",\"code\":\"account_quota_exceeded\"}\n}``` Backpressure kicking our retry queue.

sophie: @maria @devin do we have any correlation with billing refresh jobs? I see a backlog of 10k entitlement checks failing with 402-ish responses.

maria: good call. @accounting-bot can you confirm if any customer invoices/settlements are delayed in Stripe?

accounting-bot: Quick summary (automated pull): 3 enterprise accounts with recent failed payments + multiple small customers in past_due state. No org-wide outage on Stripe's status page — but rate limiting / enforcement seen on our webhook endpoints. Ticket with Stripe exists: https://support.stripe.com/tickets/REQ-12345 (opened).

ryan: Impact matrix from logs: 8% of all generation requests fail entitlement check and return 402 to the client. Most failures are for customers whose subscriptions are in past_due or have disputed invoices. Some failures caused downstream quota gating to remove tokens — causing auth failures for active sessions.

devin: mitigation plan suggestion:
- Pause non-essential billing webhooks from being processed to avoid cascading retries.
- Switch entitlement check path to cached decisions for 5m for customers with active sessions (emergency grace).
- Replay webhook queue once Stripe confirms resends or after backoff window.
- Open emergency SLA escalation with Stripe AM and request temporary lift/clarification on enforcement.

maria: I can flip the feature flag for cached entitlement now. Who can pause the webhook worker?

ashley: I can pause the non-critical webhook consumers (payments-events-low). Command I'm going to run: ```bash
# pause low-priority consumer
sudo systemctl stop payments-events-low || ./bin/workerctl pause payments-events-low
```
I'll confirm when done.

ashley: done. paused payments-events-low. Observability should drop some of the retry pressure.

devin: flipping cached entitlement flag (emergency) now. Command: ```bash
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \\n  https://console.internal/api/flags/cache-entitlement-emergency -d '{"enabled":true, "ttl_s":300}'
```

devin: flag flipped. Logs show entitlement check fallback to cache for sessions with last_valid=true. Error rate on auth checks dropped from 8% -> 2% in last 90s.

maria: good. @ashley please collect list of customers affected for comms. @sophie start draft for status page with what we know (impact, mitigation, ETA).

sophie: drafting. Preliminary status page text: "We observed Stripe webhook delivery failures causing billing-related access checks to fail for a subset of customers. We have applied temporary cached entitlements and paused lower-priority webhook processing to stabilize traffic. We're working with Stripe for permanent resolution."

ashley: early impact list (from logs):
- Acme Analytics (enterprise) — intermittent token failures
- NovaApps — failed entitlement checks, degraded throughput
- BetaCorp — webhook retries piling, some queued webhooks dropped after retry limit

samir: tagging postmortem owner: assigning to @samir. Also recommend adding test for webhook error handling and a playbook entry for billing-enforcement incidents.

devin: opened internal incident ticket: INC-2024-0456. Adding runbook steps and linked Stripe ticket.

maria: escalation status: Stripe support responded — they confirm some accounts are in enforcement due to billing indicators; engineer assigned. They've asked for my webhook sample and invoice IDs. I provided logs and requested priority review.

ryan: immediate customer mitigation options considered:
- manual resend of webhooks from Stripe dashboard once issues resolved
- grant 24-hour grace window via feature flag for sessions created prior to incident start
- allow cached tokens for read-only endpoints while write/charge flows stay gated

maria: we enabled the 24-hour grace flag for sessions created before 1718000000. That should reduce customer-visible failures for active sessions.

ashley: support note ready for impacted customers. Copy: "We're aware of billing-related access issues caused by Stripe webhook delivery errors. We've applied temporary mitigations (grace for active sessions, delayed processing of non-critical webhooks). We're actively coordinating with Stripe and will update within 2 hours. If you are seeing degraded access, please reply to this thread and include your org ID."

sophie: posting status page now. Adding link to internal incident ticket and Stripe support link.

devin: engineering mitigation checklist (in-progress):
1) paused low-priority consumers ✅
2) enabled cached entitlements ✅
3) throttle webhooks client-side exponential backoff configured ✅
4) replay queue hold until Stripe confirms resend (manual step) ⬜️
5) request refund/adjustment for any overage if enforcement was incorrect ⬜️
6) follow-up postmortem & code fixes ⬜️

maria: handoff — I'm on call for another 30m then handing to @sophie for the next shift. Sophie, please keep Stripe AM on the escalation and coordinate with support for customer replies.

sophie: taking over. I'll own until 0400 UTC. @samir please prep the postmortem skeleton so we can fill in details after final resolution.

devin: small ops note: we also saw about ~1200 webhooks in DLQ. Do not replay until Stripe confirms we should — we'll risk duplicate charges if hooks correspond to payments. I'm creating a safe replay script that dedupes by event_id.```

maria: thanks all. Current status: stable (reduced customer errors), mitigation active, working with Stripe for root cause and account-level remedies. Will update as Stripe responds.

ashley: support will send an interim mail to impacted enterprises within 30m.

sophie: added a scheduled check-in at +30m.

samir: postmortem owner confirmed. ETA for postmortem doc: 72h. Action items assigned to engineering and support orgs.

inc-bot: Incident state updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Linked: INC-2024-0456, STRIPE-REQ-12345.

maria: closing active paging for now. Thank you everyone. We'll keep this thread updated with Stripe final findings and billing resolution steps. :white_check_mark:
